column290: This dataset presents the taxonomic profiles of microbiome samples from the CoDiet study, no filtering threshold was applied
Classification: Represents the hierarchical taxonomic lineage of each species, spanning from kingdom to strain.
This denotes the full classification path of the species Phocaeicola dorei.
Each column corresponds to an individual sample, with numerical values indicating the relative abundance (%) of a given species within that sample.
Each row represents a specific microbial species or taxonomic classification, with relative abundances recorded across multiple samples.
The dataset includes only species that reached at least 0.1% RA in at least one sample, ensuring the focus remains on taxa that are meaningfully present in the microbiome.
A row labeled "UNCLASSIFIED" groups taxa that could not be confidently identified beyond a certain taxonomic level.
The values represent the percentage of each species relative to the total microbial population within a sample.
Example: If a species has a RA value of 31.15 in CD_003visit1_metaphlan, it means that 31.15% of the microbial community in that sample is composed of this species.
